blind.description: A stylized wooden entryway hall tree featuring a storage bench base, a tall carved back panel with decorative finials and an arched crest, a central round mirror, and several pegs. Hanging from the pegs are a draped green coat on the left and a draped magenta coat and brown wide-brimmed hat on the right. On the left side is an attached umbrella stand holding an umbrella with a curved handle. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with hand-painted wooden and fabric textures.
blind.from_above: An elongated rectangular wooden top view showing the wide bench seat projecting forward, the thick vertical backboard, a brown hat brim on the right, the green cloth on the left, and the umbrella handle extending on the far left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 ft 6 in tall (reaching the base of the figure's spherical head) and approximately 3 ft wide.

notes: wider than standard catalog proportions due to integrated bench and umbrella stand
